# Michael Mentzer-Hernández — Portfolio

> Instructional Designer & AI Learning Consultant | Remote | Austin, Texas, USA

## About

Michael Mentzer-Hernández (M.Ed) is an experienced instructional designer and global adult educator
with 10+ years designing learning programs for international, multicultural, and high-pressure
environments. He specializes in AI integration into learning systems, rapid e-learning development,
curriculum design, and knowledge management infrastructure. He has worked across tech (Meta),
defense (Raytheon), higher education (Austin Community College), and conflict-zone contexts
(Afghanistan, Iraq). Currently available for remote Instructional Designer, Learning Experience
Designer, AI Enablement, L&D, EdTech, and Curriculum Design roles.
